mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_market_feedback (market_deck_id, user_id, content, contact_info, status) VALUES (#{marketDeckId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{contactInfo}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_market_feedback WHERE status = #{status}

SELECT f.id, f.market_deck_id AS marketDeckId, f.user_id AS userId, f.content, f.contact_info AS contactInfo, f.status, f.create_time AS createTime, u.username, u.nickname AS userNickname, d.deck_name AS deckName FROM sys_market_feedback f INNER JOIN sys_user u ON f.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_market_deck d ON f.market_deck_id = d.id ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_market_feedback SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
